Elena (PM): Quick sync: drafting a compact launch checklist for routing + multi-region tenant lanes. Need minimum gates customers can opt into.
Marcus (Eng): We should make gates measurable: KV cache hit rate, batching tail, and model compatibility. Keep pilot conservative.
Priya (Infra): Infra gating: autoscaler <60s for 2x, scheduler supports soft/hard affinity, egress delta estimate provided. Also label-based placement to honor residency.
Sam (SRE): Ops gates: canary cadence (0.5% 24h -> 5% 72h -> 20% week), alerting on regional P95 and error-rate, tabletop runbook validated. Rollback on error-budget breach.
Owen (Sales): Customers want clear migration windows, rollback guarantees, and simple contract language. Sales asks for a one-pager describing lanes and expected cost uplift.
Nina (Legal): Will draft two short templates: pilot (no SLA) and reserved (SLA + credits). Need agreed definitions for "outage" and "data residency fallback".
Marcus (Eng): Runtime details: for pilot require KV hit >=75% steady state and batching tail < target. Also a compatibility tag on model bundles for cross-region fallbacks.
Priya (Infra): Placement modes: hard-pin, soft-prefer, no-preference. Recommend guardrail: reserved lane requires minimum commit to avoid fragmentation.
Sam (SRE): Observability: per-tenant token cost, regional latency heatmap, error budget burn rate. Retention: pilot telemetry 30d, GA 90d.
Elena (PM): Proposed lanes on canvas: Shared-soft-isolation, Reserved-dedicated, Private (VPC). Each lane gets its own acceptance checklist and contract terms.
Marcus (Eng): Unknowns to spike: KV priming penalty under churn, cross-region serialization overhead, and model parity for quantized vs fp variants. I'll lead a 2-week spike.
Priya (Infra): I'll run egress cost projections for top regions and prototype a scheduler shim (2w).
Sam (SRE): I'll draft canary playbook, alert thresholds, and incident flow (1w).
Owen (Sales): I'll prepare the GTM one-pager and a migration concierge proposal for early reserved customers (1w).
Nina (Legal): I'll drop the contract snippets in shared drive and flag migration clause language (1w).
PlannerBot: Created ticket PLAT-6042 "tenant-lanes-launch-canvas" and scheduled follow-up Tue 10:00.
Elena (PM): Please post 2-sentence owner plans here by Thu EOD. I'll consolidate the canvas and send to GTM. Thanks. :rocket:
